objective: .5*||v-r||_2^2; constraints Gv <= 0; three individual unweighted native source gradients on original protection support

support.F: Both mapper parameter blocks, 6304 coordinates; source heads excluded
support.P: All mapper and assigned source-head parameters, 6355 coordinates

outside_support: Both Adam proposal parameter values must be bitwise identical; retain theta_source there

adam.implementation: Two literal disposable torch.optim.Adam instances restored from the same current parameter and full optimizer state; original defaults preserved
adam.gradient_none_zero: None remains None, zero remains zero; proposal counters/moments follow literal Adam semantics
adam.accepted_live_state: Original float32 parameters theta_source + v; retain full-proposal first/second moments and once-incremented step counters exactly; discard source-proposal state
adam.source_only_control: All protection coefficients, including ordinary individual, are zero; dispatch directly to source_step, without parameter subtraction/addition/cast roundtrip
adam.inherited_moments: Source proposal starts from the actual inherited full-gradient moments; it is not a clean protection-free history

svd.matrix: Active gradient rows A, not A @ A.T
svd.keep_rule: singular_value > 1e-12 * largest_singular_value; all-zero matrix has rank0
svd.candidate: c=V_keep @ r; v=r-V_keep.T @ c; lambda_active=U_keep @ (c/s_keep); inactive lambda=0

kkt.complementarity_tolerance: 1e-12 * max(1, abs(lambda_t)*||g_t||_2*||v||_2); require abs(lambda_t*(g_t dot v)) <= tolerance

candidate_selection.tie_rule: Take lexicographically first KKT-valid active subset whose squared distance <= minimum + fixed tie tolerance
candidate_selection.no_feasible_candidate: Raise FloatingPointError; preserve incomplete unit failure checkpoint and stop; never substitute zero silently

quantization.apply: Form theta_source64 + v64 on support, convert each parameter directly to original float32; no correction
quantization.cast_error: e = realized_increment - v, computed in float64
quantization.ideal_primal: KKT tolerance above; no claim that stored float32 update meets it exactly
quantization.absolute_products: a_t=sum abs(g_t)*abs(realized); i_t=sum abs(g_t)*abs(v); b_t as above

zero_task_support: Preserve task and mask; its native connected-zero or None derivative becomes a zero projection constraint. Labels/rows are never modified.

diagnostics.minibatch: First continuation minibatch in each listed epoch, after three scheduled detached observer updates
diagnostics.displacement_dots: g·d_s, g·r, g·v, g·(d_s+v), and actual stored-total dots use the original protection support; F therefore excludes ordinary head displacement
diagnostics.all_steps: Compact hash-bound gzip JSONL with support/active sets/norms/dots/KKT residuals/cast bounds and exact epoch, batch hash and counters
diagnostics.epoch_summaries: Min/max/mean norms/dots, active/rank counts, zero-eligible counts, fixed source support
diagnostics.full_dimension_displacement_dots: Separate full_source_displacement_dots/full_ideal_total_displacement_dots/full_actual_total_displacement_dots include every forward parameter and therefore ordinary F head displacement; support-restricted dots remain separately retained.

shared_T.order: F three detached steps, P three detached steps from the same pre-forward model; one shared source-only step
shared_T.rng: Each interface uses its own restored prescribed torch RNG under isolated fork_rng; forward trajectory uses its restored state
shared_T.required_prefit: F-only and P-only multiple literal source-only steps reproduce shared F/P forward and observer tensors, Adam states, counts and schedules exactly
